title: One signed order that swaps, bridges and swaps again
summary: One signed order swaps the asset, bridges it to another chain and swaps it again within 2 to 15 minutes. An aggregator builds the single transaction.

basis.note: No source read for this design publishes how often a screening tool loses the link at this method. The value is an assumption and means that the trail is lost in 50 cases in 100.

parties.label: the wallet that holds the funds
a service that builds the signed order
a new wallet that receives the result

steps.say: The wallet sends the funds to the service with one signed order.

basis.note: The report says that an aggregator builds one transaction that swaps, bridges and swaps. The wait is assumed.

steps.say: The service delivers the swapped funds to a new wallet on the other chain.

basis.note: The report says that the whole route takes minutes. The wait of 2 to 15 minutes is assumed, and the service fee is not modelled.
